name: Selection gradients remain clipped and Undo restores the exact original drawing
description: A linear foreground/background pixel gradient fills only a marquee selection, uses those two colors, and can be undone as one edit without changing the remaining artwork.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the local PixiBun Studio at a 1440 by 900 desktop viewport.
Set the Foreground hex color to #ff0000.
Set the Background hex color to #0000ff.
Create a small rectangle selection in the middle of the canvas using Marquee Box.
Select Pixel Gradient with Shift+G while the drawing canvas has focus.
Drag horizontally across the selected rectangle.
Verify only the selected rectangle contains opaque red/blue pixel patterns; pixels outside it remain transparent and no interpolated colors were painted.
Verify the entire original transparent artwork is restored after this one Undo.
